name: Safekeeping Place
definition: Organisation used as the safekeeping place for the securities.

DigitalLedgerIdentification.name: Digital Ledger Identification
DigitalLedgerIdentification.definition: Place of settlement expressed with a Digital Ledger Identifier. It identifies a digital ledger or distributed ledger system (for example, blockchain or similar platforms).

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country where the financial instruments are/will be safekept.

RelatedSecuritiesAccount.name: Related Securities Account
RelatedSecuritiesAccount.definition: Account at the safekeeping place where financial instruments are safekept.

SecuritiesBalance.name: Securities Balance
SecuritiesBalance.definition: Balance which is held at a safekeeping place.

SecuritiesSettlement.name: Securities Settlement
SecuritiesSettlement.definition: Specifies the settlement operation which uses the safekeeping place.
